determinations_note: Steps 1-4 produce conforming and nonconforming. An entity with no evidence in a period is simply not assessed; turning that into an explicit insufficient_evidence verdict belongs to Step 6.
case_unit: One criterion, for one entity, in one assessment period (one week). Document-level criteria use one policy version as the entity.

methods.EXAMINE: Review a document or configuration (NIST SP 800-53A assessment method).
methods.TEST: Exercise or analyse system state or activity evidence (NIST SP 800-53A assessment method).

criteria.title: Segregation of duties
criteria.pass_condition: At the end of the period, no identity holds both entitlements of any pair listed in the Segregation of Duties matrix.
evidence: Entitlement snapshot (from OCSF 3005 User Access Management events)

criteria.title: Leavers disabled on time
criteria.pass_condition: An identity whose HR termination date has passed is disabled no later than one business day (Monday to Friday, the UAE working week) after termination, and has no successful authentication after that deadline.

criteria.title: Non-human identities have an active owner
criteria.pass_condition: Every enabled service account and AI agent has an owner who is an active employee at the end of the period.

criteria.title: Entitlements outside the role baseline are approved
criteria.pass_condition: Every entitlement held that is not in the holder's role baseline is backed by an approved access request dated on or before the grant.

criteria.title: Unused entitlements are removed
criteria.pass_condition: No entitlement held at the end of the period has gone unused for longer than the review window (90 days). Evaluated only once 90 days of activity evidence exist.
evidence: OCSF 3002 Authentication to the entitlement's asset

criteria.title: Access is justified by role (least privilege)
criteria.pass_condition: Entitlements held are justified by the holder's role and peer group, even when a formal approval exists.
criteria.truth_source: injection only (approved but inappropriate grants); approved, appropriate extra grants act as negatives
criteria.note: Judgement-based criterion: the GNN estimates whether an approved entitlement fits the holder's role and peers. A rule cannot decide it.

criteria.title: Privileged access to Critical Information Assets is pre-approved
criteria.pass_condition: Every privileged entitlement on a Critical Information Asset has an approval by the asset owner and the CISO recorded before the grant.

criteria.title: Critical Information Assets accessed only by entitled identities
criteria.pass_condition: Every successful authentication to a Critical Information Asset during the period is by an identity holding an entitlement for that asset at that time.

criteria.title: No firewall rule permits a prohibited service
criteria.pass_condition: No permit rule in force at any time during the period allows a service marked prohibited in Annex B.

criteria.title: No overly broad rules to protected zones
criteria.pass_condition: No permit rule in force at any time during the period to the DATABASE or MANAGEMENT zone uses ANY as source zone or ANY as service.

criteria.title: Firewall rules follow the zone matrix
criteria.pass_condition: Every permit rule in force at any time during the period allows only a source zone, destination zone and service combination listed in the zone matrix (Annex C).

criteria.title: Observed traffic follows the zone matrix
criteria.pass_condition: No flow observed during the period goes between zones, or uses a service, not listed in the zone matrix.

criteria.title: Connections to Critical Information Assets are encrypted
criteria.pass_condition: No flow to a Critical Information Asset during the period uses a cleartext protocol, on any port.
criteria.truth_source: nDPI application label (L7_PROTO), hidden from the checker, plus injection
criteria.note: A port rule catches cleartext on the cleartext service's own port. The ML classifier is needed when a cleartext protocol runs on a port that belongs to an encrypted service (for example HTTP on 443).
